cautions.en: This is a constructed standard female, not a scan of one person. Bones, leg and pelvis muscles and some organs come from one donor (Visible Human Female: CT and the University of Denver cryosection models, 184 parts), but they were re-posed and then scaled segment by segment to the proportions of an average young woman (stature 160.6 cm), so no part keeps the donor's true size or proportions; all are labelled "warped". The other 3102 parts are male anatomy deformed onto that skeleton.
cautions.zh: 本模型是构建出来的“标准女性”，并非某一位女性的扫描。骨骼、下肢和骨盆的肌以及部分器官来自同一位供体（Visible Human Female：CT 和丹佛大学的冰冻切片模型，共 184 个部件），但都重新摆过姿势，并逐肢段缩放到年轻女性的平均比例（身高 160.6 cm），因此没有任何部件保留供体的真实大小和比例，一律标为“形变”。其余 3102 个部件是形变贴合到这副骨架上的男性结构。

cautions.en: Her head is not her own. Its outer shape is the outline of the female head of a parametric body model (Meta's Momentum Human Rig, MHR, Apache-2.0), and her skull, mandible, teeth and the soft parts of her head (brain, facial and masticatory muscles, parotid glands, tongue, eyes, nasal cartilages, vessels, nerves) were deformed to fit inside it: the skull keeps its orientation on the cervical spine, then a smooth warp that moves bone surface by up to 20 mm. These parts are labelled "warped" and none keeps its original shape: do not judge the shape or size of any bone of the skull from this model.
cautions.zh: 她的头不是她本人的头。头的外形是一个参数化人体模型（Meta 的 Momentum Human Rig，MHR，Apache-2.0 许可）的女性头部轮廓，她的颅骨、下颌骨、牙和头部软组织（脑、表情肌和咀嚼肌、腮腺、舌、眼、鼻软骨、血管、神经）是变形进去的：颅骨在颈椎上的朝向不变，再做平滑形变，骨面最多移动 20 mm。这些部件标为“形变”，都不是原来的形状：不要据此模型判断颅骨任何一块骨的形状和大小。

cautions.en: Her teeth are the male teeth scaled down by 0.974 as a whole, a factor taken from the sexual dimorphism of mesiodistal crown widths in a meta-analysis (Silva et al. 2019, J Forensic Odontostomatol 37(1):2-19, PMC6875240). Her eyebrows are the male eyebrow part moved onto a line set by the supraorbital rim of her warped frontal bone; that in women the lower border of the brow lies just below the rim medially and a few millimetres above it laterally is from the abstract of Sclafani & Jung 2010 (Arch Facial Plast Surg 12(2):123-127), and the millimetre values and the width of the brow are assumptions. The hair of her head is still the male hair part; no female hair has been made yet.
cautions.zh: 她的牙是男性的牙整体缩小 0.974 倍，倍数取自一篇荟萃分析里牙冠近远中径的性别差异（Silva 等 2019，J Forensic Odontostomatol 37(1):2-19，PMC6875240）。眉是男性的眉部件，移到按她形变后额骨的眶上缘定出的线上；女性眉下缘在内侧略低于眶缘、外侧高出几毫米，出自 Sclafani 和 Jung 2010 年论文的摘要（Arch Facial Plast Surg 12(2):123-127），具体毫米数和眉宽是假定的。头发仍是男性的头发部件，还没有做女性的头发。

cautions.en: The hair is the male part fitted to her scalp as a stand-in: its inner face lies 0.5 mm under the scalp, and its outer face was pushed out to at least 1 mm outside the scalp where it fell short (construction, only so that no skin shows through the hair); the hairline keeps the male outline.
cautions.zh: 头发是男性的部件贴到她的头皮上作替身：内面在头皮下 0.5 mm，外面不够的地方推到头皮外至少 1 mm（构造，只为头发里不露出皮肤）；发际线仍是男性的轮廓。

cautions.en: Her stature is set, not measured: the head model is placed so that she stands 1.606 m (the project's standard; 1.6155 m before, when the skin lay on her taller vault), and her vault was lowered by about 11.2 mm to fit under it. The soft-tissue depths that place bone under the skin come from Korean, Brazilian and Nigerian women and a pooled table; none is from the population she stands for, and the depths over vault, mastoid and neck are assumptions.
cautions.zh: 她的身高是设定的，不是量出来的：头模型放在使身高为 1.606 m 的位置（项目的标准值；原先皮肤贴着她偏高的颅顶时是 1.6155 m），她的颅顶为此压低了约 11.2 mm。决定骨在皮肤下多深的软组织厚度取自韩国、巴西、尼日利亚女性的研究和一张合并表，没有一份来自她所代表的人群；颅顶、乳突和颈部的厚度是假定值。

cautions.en: What the warp changed in the skull: distance between the eyeballs +14.5 % (55 → 63 mm), height of the chin +10.9 % (23 → 25.5 mm), length of the body of the mandible −7.2 % (82.1 → 76.2 mm), bizygomatic breadth +6.1 % (117.9 → 125.1 mm), and 1 more dimension by over 5 %; locally the bone is scaled by 0.537–1.448.

Kept in the head: the fit of the occipital condyles on her atlas, the temporomandibular joints, and the occlusion (the crowns of all teeth moved as one rigid block; the roots follow the bone). The eyeballs keep their size and were moved by 8 mm into the eye openings of the head. The upper incisal edge lies 2 mm below the line between the lips (2 mm was intended).
cautions.zh: 头部保持不变的：枕髁与她的寰椎的对合、颞下颌关节、咬合（全部牙冠作为一个刚体移动，牙根随骨）。眼球大小不变，移动了 8 mm 以对上头的睑裂。上切牙切缘在唇间线下方 2 mm（原定 2 mm）。

cautions.en: Assumptions behind the head: the angle of the re-pose is a modelling choice (uncertain by about 4°; the scan is supine and has no neutral reference); how deep bone lies under the skin follows soft-tissue depth tables of Korean, Brazilian and Nigerian women, none of them the population she stands for (8 of 28 landmarks end more than 1 SD from the table); her vault was taller than the head's, so her face now sits higher against her cervical spine than it did. Hyoid, larynx, thyroid and cervical spine were not moved.
cautions.zh: 头部所依据的假定：重新摆位的角度是建模上的选择（约有 4° 的不确定；扫描是仰卧位，没有中立位的参照）；骨在皮肤下多深取自韩国、巴西和尼日利亚女性的软组织厚度表，都不是她所代表的人群（28 个标志点里有 8 个离表值超过 1 个标准差）；她的颅顶比这个头高，所以面部相对颈椎比原来高。舌骨、喉、甲状腺和颈椎没有动。

cautions.en: Proportions are imposed, not measured: segment lengths follow regressions fitted to US Army and US civilian surveys, evaluated at the mean stature of Chinese women aged 20–24. The trunk was shortened, the shoulder girdle lowered by about 7 cm, the forearms and lower legs lengthened, the pelvis narrowed by about 11 % and the feet flattened by about 20 %; the muscle envelope of the arms, chest wall, thighs and calves was thinned to fit the girths of a woman of BMI 21.6. Do not read individual bone shape, joint congruency or muscle bulk from this model.
cautions.zh: 比例是设定的，不是测得的：各肢段长度按美国陆军和美国平民测量数据拟合的回归式取值，身高取中国 20–24 岁女性的均值。躯干被缩短，肩带下移约 7 cm，前臂和小腿被加长，骨盆收窄约 11 %，足被压低约 20 %；上肢、胸壁、大腿和小腿的肌肉包络被收薄，以符合 BMI 21.6 女性的围度。不要据此模型判断单块骨的形状、关节的吻合程度或肌肉的粗细。

cautions.en: Most leg and pelvis muscles are spliced: the belly is the donor's (Denver cryosection model, bellies only) and the tendons are cut from the male muscle and moved to meet it, so the junction between belly and tendon is a join, not anatomy. Where no clean join was possible (gastrocnemius, gracilis, sartorius, semimembranosus, semitendinosus, gluteus minimus) the male muscle is shown instead.
cautions.zh: 下肢和骨盆的肌大多是拼接的：肌腹来自供体（Denver 冰冻切片模型，只有肌腹），肌腱则取自男性的同名肌并移到与肌腹对齐，所以肌腹与肌腱的交界是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。无法干净拼接的肌（腓肠肌、股薄肌、缝匠肌、半膜肌、半腱肌、臀小肌）仍用男性的肌。

cautions.en: Vessels and nerves of the leg are male structures fitted to her muscles afterwards. 2.0 % of nerve length lies more than 3 mm inside her own muscles: 1.8 % are motor branches entering the muscle they supply, 0.2 % are known passages through a muscle, and 0.1 % is not explained by anatomy. In the groin the course that the ilio-inguinal nerve and the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve take in the male, down into the scrotum, was cut off (45–86 mm); here these nerves end at the mons pubis. The femoral vessels were moved back by up to 24.6 mm to lie on her own muscles; other vessels, nerves and lymph nodes in front of those muscles moved with them. The great saphenous vein joins the femoral vein at the level of the pubic tubercle, higher than in life, as it does in the male model.
cautions.zh: 下肢的血管和神经是男性结构，事后按她的肌调整了位置。神经总长的 2.0 % 位于她自己的肌内 3 mm 以上：其中 1.8 % 是进入所支配肌的肌支，0.2 % 是已知的穿肌段，0.1 % 无法用解剖解释。腹股沟处，髂腹股沟神经和生殖股神经生殖支在男性进入阴囊的一段已剪去（45–86 mm），在这里这两条神经止于阴阜。股血管向后移了最多 24.6 mm，贴在她自己的肌上；这些肌前方的其他血管、神经和淋巴结随之移动。大隐静脉在耻骨结节的高度汇入股静脉，比真实位置高，与男性模型相同。

cautions.en: Warped parts are anchored by bone only. Between bones their position is extrapolated: expect errors of 1–3 cm for limb muscles, vessels and nerves, and more in the abdomen and pelvis.
cautions.zh: 形变部件仅以骨骼为锚点，骨与骨之间的位置靠外推得到：四肢的肌肉、血管和神经误差约 1–3 cm，腹部和盆腔更大。

cautions.en: The intercostal nerves are male centrelines carried onto her ribs. Along the ribs each lies in its own intercostal space; beyond the costal margin nothing anchored them, so the stretch of nerves 7–11 in the abdominal wall was laid out again by this project (ends moved by up to 85 mm): the 7th now ends 10 mm below the tip of her xiphoid process and the 10th at the navel of her skin, as the textbook says; the 8th and 9th are spaced evenly between them and the 11th lies 66 mm below the navel (interpolated, an assumption). Each was seated on the outer surface of transversus abdominis and behind rectus abdominis, which it pierces at its end. The navel is a dimple constructed in the skin at the level of the fourth lumbar vertebra, so these levels are constructed too. There is no subcostal nerve, and no lateral cutaneous branches are modelled.
cautions.zh: 肋间神经是男性的中心线搬到她的肋上的。沿肋的一段各在自己的肋间隙里；过了肋弓就没有可依的骨，所以第 7–11 肋间神经在腹壁里的一段由本项目重新布置（前端最多移动 85 mm）：第 7 肋间神经现在止于她剑突尖下方 10 mm，第 10 肋间神经止于她皮肤上的脐（与教科书一致）；第 8、9 在两者之间等分，第 11 在脐下 66 mm（内插，是假定）。各神经落在腹横肌的外表面、腹直肌的后面，末端穿过腹直肌。脐是在皮肤上按第四腰椎的高度构造的小凹，所以这些高度也是构造出来的。模型里没有肋下神经，也没有外侧皮支。

cautions.en: The 6th intercostal nerve, which runs in its own space to the side of the sternum, used to end beside the 7th, below her xiphoid process. Its end was brought up by up to 30 mm to the level of her xiphisternal joint, found from her own sternum and xiphoid: the dermatome map puts the T6 key point at the level of the xiphoid process (ISNCSCI), and taking the joint, the upper end of the xiphoid, is this project's choice. Only the stretch beyond the bony ribs was moved, and none of it lies in bone or cartilage.
cautions.zh: 第 6 肋间神经在自己的肋间隙里走到胸骨旁，前端原先落在第 7 肋间神经的前端旁边、剑突以下。现在把它的前端提高最多 30 mm，到她的剑胸结合的高度（按她自己的胸骨和剑突求出）：皮节图（ISNCSCI）把 T6 的关键点放在剑突的高度，取剑胸结合即剑突的上端是本项目的选择。只移动了骨性肋以外的一段，没有一处落在骨或软骨里。

cautions.en: The pelvic floor, the anal and urethral sphincters, the perineal muscles, clitoris and vestibular bulbs, the urethra, vagina, rectum and anal canal, uterus, tubes and ovaries (53 parts) are real female anatomy, but of ANOTHER woman, not of the donor of the skeleton (Wu et al. 2015: a young adult of the Chinese Visible Human series). Her structures were reconstructed from cryosections and smoothed by the authors of that study, enlarged 1.096 times and fitted to this pelvis by its bones (to about 2 mm), then narrowed by 11 % together with the pelvis.
cautions.zh: 盆底肌、肛门括约肌和尿道括约肌、会阴肌、阴蒂和前庭球、尿道、阴道、直肠和肛管、子宫、输卵管和卵巢（共 53 个部件）是真实的女性解剖结构，但来自另一位女性，不是这副骨架的供体（Wu 等 2015 年的研究：中国可视化人体数据集中的一位年轻成年女性）。这些结构由该研究的作者根据冰冻切片重建并做过平滑，本模型把它们放大 1.096 倍，按骨性标志配准到这个骨盆上（误差约 2 mm），又随骨盆一起横向收窄 11 %。

cautions.en: Left and right halves of the specimen's pelvic structures were separated by this project, and where neighbouring structures overlapped the less important one was reshaped by up to 8 mm. Do not read sizes, exact positions or left–right differences from these parts.
cautions.zh: 这些盆腔结构的左右两半是本项目切分的；相邻结构有重叠的地方，次要的一方被重新塑形，最多移动 8 mm。不要据此判断这些结构的大小、精确位置或左右差异。

cautions.en: Three sources meet in the lesser pelvis, and where they meet the model is a join, not anatomy. The bladder, bones and obturator internus are the donor's; her bladder is almost empty (35.7 ml), its neck was drawn 12.1 mm onto the upper end of the other woman's urethra and its base 13 mm back onto the anterior vaginal wall. The uterus stands as it did in the other woman, whose bladder was full, so an unnatural gap remains between bladder and uterus.
cautions.zh: 小骨盆里有三个来源的结构，它们相接的地方是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。膀胱、骨和闭孔内肌来自骨架的供体；她的膀胱几乎是空的（35.7 ml），膀胱颈被拉动 12.1 mm 接到另一位女性的尿道上端，膀胱底向后移了 13 mm 贴近阴道前壁。子宫保持它在另一位女性体内的位置，而那位女性的膀胱是充盈的，所以膀胱与子宫之间留有一段不自然的空隙。

cautions.en: The sigmoid colon, ureters, vessels, nerves and lymph nodes are male structures: the end of the sigmoid colon was moved 19.6 mm to meet the upper end of the rectum (which is cut off at the top of the specimen), the bowel was shifted by up to 32 mm to clear the uterus, left tube and left ovary, and vessels that ran through these organs were pushed to their surface; some still cut through them. Uterine artery, Uterine vein, Mesovarium, Suspensory ligament of ovary, Uterovesical pouch are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) moved 2–4 cm onto these organs.
cautions.zh: 乙状结肠、输尿管、血管、神经和淋巴结是男性结构：乙状结肠末端被移动 19.6 mm 去对接直肠上端（直肠在标本上缘处被截断），肠管整体移动了最多 32 mm 以避开子宫、左输卵管和左卵巢，原本穿过这些器官的血管被推到器官表面，仍有少数从中穿过。子宫动脉、子宫静脉、卵巢系膜、卵巢悬韧带、膀胱子宫陷凹是美术建模（Human Reference Atlas），被移动 2–4 cm 贴到这些器官上。

cautions.en: The left uterosacral ligament (82.2 → 51.1 mm), right cardinal ligament (72.5 → 43.2 mm), right uterosacral ligament (82.2 → 62 mm) are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) re-fitted by two ends: the end on the sacrum or pelvic wall was kept, the other end was moved onto the cervix shown here, and the ligament was shortened along its length. They are schematic bands between attachment sites taken from textbook anatomy, not dissected ligaments.
cautions.zh: 左骶子宫韧带（82.2 → 51.1 mm）、右主韧带（72.5 → 43.2 mm）、右骶子宫韧带（82.2 → 62 mm）是美术模型（Human Reference Atlas），按两端重新配准：骶骨或盆壁一端保持原位，另一端移到这里显示的宫颈上，韧带沿长轴缩短。它们是连接附着点的示意性条带（附着点按教科书解剖确定），不是解剖出来的韧带。

cautions.en: The gap between bladder and uterus (16.6 mm) lies between the back of the empty bladder and the cervix; tilting the uterine body forwards by up to 30° would not close it, so the uterus was left as in the specimen. The cervix lies 9.8–17.5 mm to the left of the median plane of the pelvis; it does so in the specimen itself (11–16 mm from the median plane of its own bones, measured in the source data), so it was not straightened, and the ligaments that have no room on that side are absent. The posterior vaginal wall and the rectum are apposed through the rectovaginal septum (closer than 1 mm over 36 mm²).
cautions.zh: 膀胱与子宫之间的空隙（16.6 mm）位于空膀胱后壁与宫颈之间，把子宫体前倾 30° 也合不上，所以子宫保持标本中的位置。宫颈偏在骨盆正中面左侧 9.8–17.5 mm；标本本身就是这样（在原始数据里量得偏离它自己骨的正中面 11–16 mm），所以没有扶正，该侧放不下的韧带仍然缺失。阴道后壁与直肠隔着直肠阴道隔相贴（相距不足 1 mm 的面积为 36 mm²）。

cautions.en: The arms are not where her bones were posed. Her upper limbs lay against her sides, with latissimus dorsi, teres major and pectoralis major so close to the arm that no skin could pass between arm and trunk (8.9 / 8.6 mm, left / right, at 40–45% of the length of the humerus). Each free limb, with everything in it, was therefore turned 7.5° outwards in the coronal plane about the centre of the humeral head, the smallest angle that leaves 12 mm there (now 13.8 / 13 mm); the scapulae and clavicles were not moved. The 39 muscles, tendons and ligaments that cross the shoulder joint and the vessels and nerves of the axilla were deformed to follow (159 parts), so their shape there is constructed. Proximal to that level the axillary folds still lie against the arm, as they do in life.
cautions.zh: 上肢不在她的骨原先摆放的位置。她的两臂原本贴在身侧，背阔肌、大圆肌和胸大肌紧挨着上臂，臂与躯干之间没有皮肤能通过的空隙（肱骨长度 40–45% 处，左 / 右 8.9 / 8.6 mm）。因此把每侧游离上肢连同其中的一切，绕肱骨头中心在冠状面内向外转了 7.5°——这是在该处让出 12 mm 的最小角度（现在为 13.8 / 13 mm）；肩胛骨和锁骨没有动。跨过肩关节的 39 个肌、腱、韧带以及腋窝的血管、神经随之形变（共 159 个部件），它们在该处的形状是构造出来的。该平面以近，腋襞仍贴着上臂，活体也是如此。

cautions.en: The body surface is a parametric model skin (Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1), not a scan and not her own skin: a surface shaped as a standard female body and then relaxed outwards over her muscles until it encloses them. It is heavier than intended: BMI 23.7 by enclosed volume against a target of 21.6. The shoulders and upper arms are fuller than the target (bideltoid breadth 478 mm against 454 mm).
cautions.zh: 体表是参数化模型皮肤（Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1），不是扫描所得，也不是她本人的皮肤：先做成标准女性体形的表面，再向外松弛到把她的肌肉包住。它比设定的要胖：按所围体积算 BMI 为 23.7，目标是 21.6。肩部和上臂比目标粗（两侧三角肌间宽 478 mm，目标 454 mm）。

cautions.en: The navel is not hers: it is a dimple constructed in the skin (5.3 mm deep, 17 mm wide, an assumed size), set at the level of the centre of the body of the fourth lumbar vertebra. The crotch of the skin was raised towards her perineal structures, by up to 24.4 mm; the points it was drawn towards still lie a median 6.2 mm and at most 28.4 mm from it. It carries no vulvar anatomy (no labia, vestibule or openings): the perineal skin of the pelvic-floor specimen was located on her but could not be set into the skin (the rim of the patch still lies a median 11.6 mm from the skin).
cautions.zh: 脐不是她本人的：是在皮肤上构造出来的一个小凹（深 5.3 mm，宽 17 mm，尺寸是假定的），高度取第四腰椎椎体中心。皮肤的会阴部已朝她的会阴结构抬高，最多 24.4 mm；它所趋向的目标点离它仍有中位数 6.2 mm、最远 28.4 mm。它没有外阴的解剖结构（没有阴唇、前庭和开口）：盆底标本的会阴皮肤已在她身上定位，但没能接进皮肤（这一片的外缘离皮肤中位数 11.6 mm）。

cautions.en: Her face is the skin model's female face (see the cautions on the head), not a face of her own. The eyes, the mouth and the nose are the skin model's.
cautions.zh: 她的面孔是皮肤模型的女性面孔（见关于头部的说明），不是她本人的面孔。眼、口、鼻都是皮肤模型的。

cautions.en: The eyes and the mouth of the skin are real openings. The membrane between the lids was removed, so what shows in each eye is the globe of the anatomy data, and the lips are cut apart along the oral fissure (closed at rest). Behind the openings, the lid rims turned in towards the globes and the oral pouch round teeth, gums and tongue are construction aids that only hide the hollow inside of the body: they are not anatomy (there is no conjunctiva and no oral mucosa). The deep "Lip" part lies in the oral opening and is meant to be hidden while the skin is opaque.
cautions.zh: 皮肤上的眼和口是真正的开口：两睑之间的封膜已删去，洞里露出的是解剖数据里的眼球；上下唇沿口裂剪开，静止时闭合。洞口后面朝向眼球的睑缘内卷、包住牙、牙龈和舌的口腔袋都是构造物，只为不露出体内的空腔，不是解剖（没有结膜，也没有口腔黏膜）。深层的“唇”部件正位于口裂处，皮肤不透明时应隐藏。

cautions.en: The toes are separate, with webs and nails, but they are not hers: they come from an artist-made foot mesh (Blender Studio Human Base Meshes, CC0), each toe placed along her toe bones and widened until it covers them; the third to fifth toes are stretched 1.22–1.43 times to reach along her phalanges and look slender; the nails are shapes in the skin mesh, apart from the nail plate parts. About 2 cm of skin behind the toe bases is a constructed transition (triangles up to 21 mm long). Where the web station lies on the proximal phalanx is an assumption.
cautions.zh: 足趾是分开的，有趾蹼和趾甲，但不是她本人的：取自人工建模的足部网格（Blender Studio Human Base Meshes，CC0），每个趾沿她的趾骨摆放并加粗到盖住趾骨；第 3–5 趾被拉长到 1.22–1.43 倍才够到她的趾骨，显得细长；趾甲是皮肤网格上的形状，与甲板部件无关。趾根之后约 2 cm 的皮肤是构造的过渡面（三角形最长 21 mm）。趾蹼在近节趾骨上的位置是假定的。

cautions.en: The grafted toes still show small faults: near the tips of the second to fifth toes a shallow ring step runs where the tip cap meets the shaft (under 1 mm; a hollow of up to about 1.5 mm on the second toe), a short crease lies beside the nail of the great toe, and a faint step crosses the back of each forefoot where the graft meets the fitted skin. On the shipped mesh 0 edges of the left graft and 0 of the right are folded right over (neighbouring facets more than 150° apart).
cautions.zh: 移植的足趾仍有看得见的小毛病：第 2–5 趾近趾尖处，趾尖帽与趾身相接的地方有一圈浅台阶（不到 1 mm；第二趾上有一处深约 1.5 mm 的小凹），大趾甲旁有一道短折痕，足背前部移植片与拟合皮肤相接处有一道浅台阶。在发布的网格上，左足移植片有 0 条边、右足有 0 条边完全对折（相邻小面夹角超过 150°）。

cautions.en: Round the eyes and the lips the skin was deliberately not pushed out, and measured against the skin as it was before the openings were cut, what lies under it comes through: the inner (palpebral) ring of orbicularis oculi by up to 2.6 mm, the cornea by 1.1 mm, the lips by 0.7 mm. The face keeps the full resolution of the surface (16430 vertices, mean edge 1.72 mm), as do the grafted patches; the rest of the skin is simplified.
cautions.zh: 眼和唇周围的皮肤有意不外推；按开口之前的皮肤量，有结构露出皮肤：眼轮匝肌内环（睑部）最多 2.6 mm、角膜 1.1 mm、唇 0.7 mm。面部保留体表的原始分辨率（16430 个顶点，平均边长 1.72 mm），移植片也是；其余皮肤经过简化。

cautions.en: The breasts on the surface are the skin model's. The gland, ducts, fat, areola and nipple inside them are an artist model (Human Reference Atlas) of a larger breast in standing shape (by the skin author's measurement it projects 79 mm (left) and 82 mm (right) from the chest wall, the breast of the skin 56 mm and 54 mm), scaled to 0.51 of its size on both sides and moved about 3 cm down, as the placement file of the skin package says, to fit under that skin. Their size and their place on the chest wall are therefore not anatomical data.
cautions.zh: 体表上的乳房是皮肤模型的。其内的腺体、导管、脂肪、乳晕和乳头是美术模型（Human Reference Atlas），原本是更大的站立位乳房（前突 79 / 82 mm，皮肤的乳房只有 56 / 54 mm，皮肤作者量），按皮肤包的摆放文件两侧都缩小到原大小的 0.51，并下移约 3 cm，才放得进这层皮肤。因此它们的大小和在胸壁上的位置都不是解剖数据。

cautions.en: The skin was fitted to enclose muscles, bones, cartilages and organs only; fasciae, cutaneous nerves, superficial vessels and joint capsules were then brought under it by this project. 100 of them were moved inwards by a smooth displacement to lie at least 2.5 mm under the skin (by up to 20 mm), among them the fascia lata, which stood out at the root of each thigh (65 cm²). The vessels and nerves of fingers and toes were moved into their own digit; where that would have put them into a finger or toe bone the move was held back (2384 points), and 4.5 % of their surface lies inside bone (4.0 % before). These positions follow the skin, not a scan.
cautions.zh: 皮肤拟合时只保证包住肌、骨、软骨和器官；筋膜、皮神经、浅血管和关节囊是本项目事后收到皮肤之内的：100 个部件用平滑的位移向内移动，使其至少在皮下 2.5 mm（最多移动 20 mm），包括原先在两侧大腿根部翻出皮肤的阔筋膜（65 cm²）。指、趾的血管和神经被移进各自的指、趾；会因此落进指骨、趾骨的地方位移被收回（2384 个点），它们的表面仍有 4.5 % 在骨内（之前 4.0 %）。这些位置是跟着皮肤定的，不是扫描所得。

cautions.en: Measured by area, 153.6 cm² of the treated thin structures lay outside the skin before and 10.03 cm² after; over all thin structures 17.43 cm² of 46865 cm² (0.04%) is still outside the shipped skin, 10.71 cm² of it by more than 1 mm, most of it on the oral cavity proper (7.3 cm², up to 8 mm). The crural fascia arrives already cut off at the bases of the toes (in the male build), so nothing of it spans the web spaces any more. Surface parts made for the earlier skin do not sit on this one: perionyx (foot), eyebrow, nail plate, nail plate (foot), pubic hair, perionyx, hair of head.
cautions.zh: 按面积量：被处理的薄结构原先有 153.6 cm² 在皮肤外，处理后为 10.03 cm²；全部薄结构 46865 cm² 中仍有 17.43 cm²（0.04%）在发布的皮肤之外，其中 10.71 cm² 超出 1 mm，最多的是“Oral cavity proper”（7.3 cm²，最多 8 mm）。小腿筋膜在男性构建里已在趾根剪掉，不再横在趾蹼之间。为旧皮肤做的体表部件（头发、眉、甲等）与这层皮肤对不上。

cautions.en: The lips under the skin are two parts, "Upper lip" and "Lower lip": the single scanned "Lip" of the male body, a thin shell of both vermilions, was cut along its own fissure in the male build, the cut faces were closed with constructed caps, and both halves were deformed onto her and moved forwards under the lip surface of her skin. They lie in the mouth opening of the skin and are meant to be hidden while the skin is opaque.
cautions.zh: 皮肤下的唇是两个部件（上唇、下唇）：男性身体上扫描得到的单个“Lip”是上下唇红连成的一片薄壳，在男性构建里沿它自己的口裂切开，切口用构造的面封上；两半再形变到她身上，并前移到她皮肤的唇面之下。它们位于皮肤的口裂处，皮肤不透明时应隐藏。

cautions.en: Muscle bulk and position were then changed again to fit a target body surface: a parametric female skin (stature 160.6 cm, BMI 21.6) less the subcutaneous fat expected at each place. Muscles, tendons, warped organs, vessels and nerves were pushed in, and in places pulled out, by up to 28.7 mm with one smooth field that is zero on bone; 58 muscles lost more than a quarter of their volume (calf, abdominal wall, forearm extensors, neck). 12 % of the muscle and organ surface still lies outside that target, mostly thin muscle lying directly on bone. Muscle thickness, cross-section and volume in this model are therefore not anatomical data.
cautions.zh: 之后又按一个目标体表改动了肌肉的粗细和位置：目标是参数化的女性皮肤（身高 160.6 cm，BMI 21.6）向内减去各处应有的皮下脂肪。肌、腱、形变来的器官、血管和神经被一个在骨面上为零的平滑位移场推入（个别地方拉出），最多 28.7 mm；58 块肌的体积减少了四分之一以上（小腿、腹壁、前臂伸肌、颈部）。仍有 12 % 的肌和器官表面在目标之外，主要是直接贴在骨上的薄肌。因此本模型中肌肉的厚度、横截面和体积都不是解剖数据。

cautions.en: On the head and neck the target surface is a face built on her skull from published soft-tissue depths (5 % of the muscle surface of the head and 21 % of that of the neck still lie outside it; sternocleidomastoid, which is her own and comes from a heavier donor, most of all). The lips were moved forwards to lie under its lip surface (lower lip by 5 mm, upper lip by 4.8 mm, orbicularis oris by 8 mm, median) as a whole, and the muscles that run into the lips follow at their labial end and keep their bony origins (their volume changed by at most 80 %).
cautions.zh: 头颈部的目标体表是按她的颅骨和已发表的软组织厚度做的面部（头部肌表面仍有 5 %、颈部仍有 21 % 在目标之外，以胸锁乳突肌为最——它是她自己的，来自体重更大的供体）。唇被前移到目标唇面之下（下唇 5 mm、上唇 4.8 mm、口轮匝肌 8 mm，中位数），整块平移；止于唇的各肌靠唇的一端随之移动，骨上的起点不动（体积变化最多 80 %）。
皮下脂肪层是在上述合成体表与她的肌肉、骨骼、器官外包络之间按 3 mm 体素填充得到的（最深只算到皮下 3 cm），并非扫描所得；其厚度取决于合成的皮肤，不代表女性真实的脂肪分布。
cautions.en: The subcutaneous fat layer fills the gap between that synthetic body surface and the outer envelope of her muscles, bones and organs at 3 mm voxels (no deeper than 3 cm below the skin); it is not scanned, and its thickness follows the synthetic skin rather than a real female fat distribution.

Absent from the pelvis: labia, vestibule and the skin of the vulva (the body surface there is smooth); the mucosa and lumen of the urethra; ovarian and vaginal vessels; the autonomic pelvic plexuses. The iliococcygeus is not a separate part: the source describes the pubococcygeus and iliococcygeus together as a "pubovisceral muscle" with an inner and an external layer. Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) and the male pelvic floor and rectum were removed, as were male structures that would lie inside the female organs (postvesical nodes).
cautions.zh: 盆腔中缺失的结构：阴唇、阴道前庭和外阴皮肤（该处的体表是光滑的）；尿道的黏膜和管腔；卵巢血管和阴道血管；盆腔自主神经丛。髂尾肌不是单独的部件：数据来源把耻尾肌和髂尾肌合称“耻骨内脏肌”，分为内层和外层。男性特有结构（前列腺、睾丸、阴茎、精囊、睾丸血管、男性尿道）以及男性的盆底肌和直肠已删除，落在女性器官内部的男性结构（postvesical nodes）也已删除。

cautions.en: Pelvic ligaments also absent: left cardinal ligament (only 10.1 mm between its attachments for a ligament modelled 70.5 mm long), left ovarian ligament (only 11.1 mm between its attachments for a ligament modelled 29.8 mm long), right ovarian ligament (only 4.1 mm between its attachments for a ligament modelled 31.2 mm long), broad ligament of uterus, left mesosalpinx, right mesosalpinx (the tubes lie against the ovaries, and in this specimen the peritoneum beside the uterus lies directly on tube and ovary; only 20–28 % of it is free, in scraps, so there is no fold to show).
cautions.zh: 同样缺失的盆腔韧带：左主韧带（两附着点之间只有 10.1 mm，而模型中的韧带长 70.5 mm）、左卵巢固有韧带（两附着点之间只有 11.1 mm，而模型中的韧带长 29.8 mm）、右卵巢固有韧带（两附着点之间只有 4.1 mm，而模型中的韧带长 31.2 mm）、子宫阔韧带、左输卵管系膜、右输卵管系膜（输卵管紧贴卵巢，该标本中子宫旁的腹膜直接贴在输卵管和卵巢上，游离的只有 20–28 %，且是碎片，没有可显示的皱襞）。

cautions.en: Pose is reconstructed: the donor was scanned lying down with bent elbows and pointed feet, and each bone was moved rigidly into a standing pose. Joint spaces at the elbow, knee, ankle and shoulder are approximate, and the scapulae and clavicles keep their lying-down position. Her left acromion is about 16 mm shorter in front than the right in the CT segmentation, and the origin of the left deltoid overhangs it.
cautions.zh: 姿势是重建的：供体扫描时为仰卧、屈肘、足跖屈，各骨被逐一刚性移动到站立姿势。肘、膝、踝、肩的关节间隙只是近似，肩胛骨和锁骨仍保持仰卧时的位置。CT 分割出的左肩峰前端比右侧短约 16 mm，左三角肌的起点有一部分悬在它前方。

cautions.en: Right radius, ulna and the bones of both hands and feet are not her scanned bones: the right forearm is a mirrored copy of the left (the scan cut it off), and hand and foot bones are warped male bones with extended fingers. The finger bones lie beyond her own hand anchors; each finger was turned at its knuckle so that the angles within the hand are those of the male hand. Her toe bones are male bones scaled to her toes; the registration had left them lifted 13–22° at the ball of the foot, and they were laid back on the floor at the joint angles of the male foot (now -20° to -5°; the outer toes slope down more steeply than the male's because her outer metatarsal heads sit higher). The ankle is still about 16 mm too high (lateral malleolus 77.5 mm against 61.8 mm): lowering it further would distort her tarsal bones.
cautions.zh: 右侧桡骨、尺骨以及双手、双足的骨并非她的扫描骨：右前臂是左前臂的镜像（扫描视野将其截断），手骨和足骨是形变后的男性骨，手指呈伸直状。指骨在她自己的手骨锚点之外；每根手指在掌指关节处转过一个角度，使手内的角度与男性的手相同。她的趾骨是男性的骨，按她足趾的大小缩放；配准后趾骨在跖趾关节处上翘 13–22°，现已按男性足的关节角度放回地面（现为 -20° 至 -5°；外侧几趾比男性的更向下倾，因为她外侧的跖骨头位置偏高）。踝仍高出约 16 mm（外踝 77.5 mm，目标 61.8 mm）：再降低就会使她的跗骨变形。

cautions.en: The donor had six lumbar vertebrae. A standard five-lumbar spine is shown: her first lumbar vertebra was removed and everything above it moved down by one segment, so the thoracolumbar junction is a join, not anatomy. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.
cautions.zh: 供体有六节腰椎。这里显示的是标准的五节腰椎：去掉了她的第一腰椎，其上方的全部结构下移一个椎节，因此胸腰交界处是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。肋骨编号来自自动分割，左侧第 5–9 肋的编号不可靠。

cautions.en: Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.
cautions.zh: 她的扫描器官（肾、脾、胰、肾上腺、胆囊、膀胱、臀肌）处于仰卧、死后的位置，与本应相连的形变血管和管道不一定对得上。肺、心、肝、胃和肠是形变后的男性器官。
空腔器官的“腔”不是扫描出来的：是把器官外表面向内缩一个壁厚得到的，壁厚取自文献或是假设值（见壁厚表）。器官之间的衔接、穿过器官两端封盖的部分是构造的，中心线上约 4% 在任何壁之外。壁本身没有改动。
cautions.en: The lumina of the hollow organs are not scanned: each is the organ's outer surface moved inward by a wall thickness taken from the literature or assumed (see the wall table). The joins between organs and the stretches through an organ's end caps are constructed; about 4% of the centreline lies outside any wall. The walls themselves are unchanged.

cautions.zh: 小肠在数据里是 55 片互相重叠的短段（相邻两片重叠深度的中位数 6.3 mm）。腔按这些片的并集来推，接头处不再收窄；但多数接头折回 130° 以上，两段并排处壁已融在一起，腔在那里各让一半、在急弯内侧收窄，所以空肠和回肠的腔只占“并集内缩一个壁厚”的约 59%，路径也比真实的肠管短。
cautions.en: The small intestine is 55 short overlapping pieces in the data (median overlap of neighbours 6.3 mm). The lumen is derived from the union of the pieces and no longer narrows at the junctions; but most junctions fold back by 130° or more and where two limbs lie side by side their walls are merged, so the lumina each give half there and narrow on the inside of sharp bends: jejunal and ileal lumina hold about 59% of the union eroded by one wall, and the path is shorter than a real bowel.

cautions.zh: 口腔和咽的腔是这副人体里舌、腭骨、牙、咽缩肌、椎前肌、会厌和喉软骨之间剩下的空间（约 85 cm² 贴着真实部件，离部件留 1.4 mm）；没有部件可依的边界是构造的（约 27 cm²），包括通鼻腔处和喉口。这里没有软腭和黏膜的部件；窄于约 6 mm 的缝分辨不出；喉口只标了位置，没有气道的腔。
cautions.en: The cavities of mouth and pharynx are the space left between this body's tongue, palatal bones, teeth, constrictors, prevertebral muscles, epiglottis and laryngeal cartilages (about 85 cm² against real parts, kept 1.4 mm clear of them); boundaries with no part to follow are constructed (about 27 cm²), among them the way to the nose and the laryngeal inlet. There is no soft-palate or mucosa part; gaps narrower than about 6 mm are not resolved; the laryngeal inlet is only marked, with no airway lumen.

cautions.zh: 充盈度从 0 到 1：0 是表里的塌陷口径，1 是不动的壁所能容下的最大。壁不随充盈变形，所以塌陷的腔外面是按扫描大小画的壁。食管和胃静止时塌陷有出处；其余器官的静止状态、各段的塌陷口径和括约肌的收窄都是假设。
cautions.en: Filling runs from 0 to 1: 0 is the tabled collapsed calibre, 1 the most the unmoving wall can hold. Walls do not deform with filling, so a collapsed lumen sits inside a wall drawn at its scanned size. That oesophagus and stomach are collapsed at rest is sourced; the resting state of the other organs, the collapsed calibres and the narrowing at sphincters are assumptions.

cautions.zh: 女性的直肠腔、宫腔、宫颈管和阴道腔是标本自己的腔面（后三者由原来合在一起的一个部件按中心线分成），没有充盈位移。尿道没有腔部件：黏膜下层上段约 18 mm 有一个孔，下段是实心的。她的输尿管和输卵管壁薄且经过形变，有几站壁里放不下腔，那里腔沿中心线以一条缝通过，标为构造。
cautions.en: The female's rectal lumen, uterine cavity, cervical canal and vaginal lumen are the specimen's own lumen surfaces (the last three split along the centreline from one combined part) and carry no filling displacement. There is no urethral lumen part: the upper 18 mm or so of the submucous layer has a bore, the lower stretch is solid. Her ureters and uterine tubes are thin and warped: at a few stations the wall leaves no room, and there the lumen passes along the centreline as a slit, labelled construction.

Her skin has no vulvar and no anal opening: the vulva graft of the skin package is not on this skin. The vaginal lumen therefore ends blind (its lowest point 33 mm under the skin), and the anal canal, which is constructed, runs to the place on the skin where the anus would be, but the skin is not open there.
cautions.zh: 她的皮肤上没有外阴和肛门的开口：皮肤包的外阴移植片没有接到这层皮肤上。所以阴道腔是盲端（最低处在皮肤下 33 mm），构造的肛管通到皮肤上肛门应在的位置，但那里的皮肤没有开口。

cautions.en: Everything said about the male model also applies to the warped parts: nerves, ligaments and lymph nodes are artist-modelled with schematic nerve thickness; phrenic nerve, pleura, pericardium, spinal cord, menisci and cruciate ligaments are absent.
cautions.zh: 男性模型的各项注意事项同样适用于形变部件：神经、韧带和淋巴结为美术建模，神经粗细仅为示意；膈神经、胸膜、心包、脊髓、半月板和交叉韧带缺失。
